thread:
maria: Quick Q on rate-limit behavior for POST /v1/infer — can per-route burst allow short spikes without returning 429? Planning compatibility for older SDKs. cc @ajay @kevin

ajay: Short answer: depends on quota/burst config. We currently have per-route token quotas plus a global token pool. For bursts we allow token oversubscribe up to `burst_window` (config) before returning 429. But we haven't standardized headers.

kevin: We saw a bunch of 429s in last canary because SDK retries treat any 429 as hard fail. We should add Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers so clients can make better decisions. :+1:

sophia: Agree. Proposal: return 429 with headers: Retry-After (seconds), X-RateLimit-Limit (req/min), X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch secs), X-RateLimit-Burst (allowed burst tokens). For burst smoothing, include X-RateLimit-Smoothing (ms window).

ben: Minor note: some clients use token-based accounting; for embeddings we bill per-embedding unit. Add X-RateLimit-Unit: tokens|req to signal which metric.

ajay: Compatibility: older clients expect only Retry-After. We'll keep Retry-After for backcompat and add new headers optionally. Server should include new headers only when route supports them. Also don't conflate 429s from rate limits with 429s from bad payloads.

maria: Plan: implement headers, document them in API contract, and roll out to Dedicated customers first behind a feature flag. @kevin can you add SDK integration tests for 429 + headers?

kevin: I'll add tests in eng-infra and update canary to inject spike load with burst_window=100ms. Expected: after burst, clients get Retry-After small values and X-RateLimit-Remaining=0. Will ping with PR link.

ajay: Server-side config sketch:
```
rate_limit:
  window_sec: 60
  limit_rpm: 1200
  burst_tokens: 50
  smoothing_ms: 200
```
We smooth bursts with a leaky-bucket decay over smoothing_ms and return X-RateLimit-Burst with available tokens.

sophia: Docs action: I'll add example 429 responses and a backcompat note. Also recommend retries: exponential backoff + jitter, and honor Retry-After if present.

rate-limit-bot: deploy bot: canary started for eng-platform/v1-rate-limiting @sophia @ajay — v2.3.1 — https://deploys.internal/xyz

ben: Heads-up: billing worries clients might react to burst headers by increasing usage. @maria please confirm product/billing stance.

maria: Product OK if we keep quota caps and per-customer limits. I'll file billingsync ticket and loop in finance.

ajay: I'll open PR + draft changelog. Keep 429 JSON body consistent:
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded",
    "meta": {"retry_after": 3}
  }
}
```
Always include message field.

kevin: SGTM. Also add telemetry tags: rate_limit.type=burst|steady and route=<route> so we can triage.

sophia: :thumbsup: I'll schedule docs review for tomorrow.
